items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Nick, what was his name? Stuck at the G. Gagliano?

ctx.x: He's doing okay. He's working at WDSU TV. Is it late? Yeah, he runs a motion picture projector and stuff. You know, he was always like tape machines and motion picture projectors and stuff like that. So he's there. I saw him last night and he might have to tell us what happened to those kids. And who came to the American Legion there? I mean, we had Don and me and a few people. Nick. Who? Nick?
Nick, what was his name? Stuck at the G. Gagliano?
Yeah. Yeah, he liked it. Yeah.
